titulo: Introductions, countries, numbers 0 to 20 and age (tener): Greetings and introductions

aula.titulo: Introductions, countries, numbers 0 to 20 and age (tener)
aula.objetivo: Introduce yourself and introduce someone else, say where you're from and where you live, use nationalities in the masculine and feminine, and count from 0 to 20, including saying your age with the verb «tener».

itens.pt: pleased to meet you (said by a man), (said by a woman)

blocos.titulo: Introducing yourself and introducing someone else
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: to say your name, use «Me llamo Ana.» Literally, «I call myself Ana». The verb is «llamarse», with the pronoun «me, te, se» before the verb: «me llamo», «te llamas», «se llama». You can also say «Soy Ana.» STEP 2: to ask someone's name: informal, «¿Cómo te llamas?»; formal, «¿Cómo se llama usted?». STEP 3: when you meet someone, say «Mucho gusto» or, shorter, «Encantado» (a man speaking) and «Encantada» (a woman speaking). The reply is «Igualmente» or «Mucho gusto». STEP 4: to introduce someone else: «Este es Luis.» (a man) or «Esta es Marta.» (a woman). STEP 5: «apellido» means surname, not «a nickname» (a nickname is «apodo»). In Spain and much of Latin America, people have two surnames: the father's and the mother's, as in «Ana García López». STEP 6: with strangers, use «señor» or «señora» with the surname: «Buenos días, señora García.» STEP 7: to move from «usted» to «tú», it's usually the older or higher-status person who suggests it.
blocos.comparacao: English says «my name is» rather than «I call myself», so the literal construction («me llamo») has no direct English match — treat it as a set phrase to learn, not a translation of English. What does carry over: «encantado» and «encantada» change with the speaker's own gender (something English «pleased to meet you» doesn't do), and «apellido» is a false friend for «a nickname» — it actually means «surname».

erros.motivo: It's a reflexive verb: «me llamo», with «me».
«Este» is masculine; for a woman, use «esta».

blocos.enunciado: Introduce yourself out loud: «Hola, me llamo… Mucho gusto.» Then introduce a male friend and a female friend: «Este es… Esta es…»
Answer out loud: «¿Eres estudiante? ¿Es usted médica? ¿Cómo es Pablo?» Then conjugate «ser» from memory.
